outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ONE production sprite atlas for the existing Eastward post-apocalyptic JRPG. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not an edit target. Create exactly TWELVE separate full-body NPC combat sprites in a perfectly regular 4 columns by 3 rows grid on genuinely transparent background, landscape 1536x1152. Each cell exactly one complete figure centered, all feet aligned near cell bottom, generous transparent gutters, no overlap, no text, no labels, no frames, no ground or cast shadow outside silhouette. Match the reference monsters precisely: detailed hand-painted 16-bit pixel clusters, controlled dark outlines, granular highlights, rusty leather and metal, subdued purple/brown/teal palette, amber accents, three-quarter front battle view. NOT chibi, NOT large heads, NOT flat geometric vector drawings. Adult human scale about 5 heads tall; figures comparably detailed to reference's human raider. These are individual wasteland travellers of 12 races, wearing practical patched neutral coats, trousers, belts and boots (or anatomical equivalent), alert guarded battle poses. Every figure holds a clearly visible short improvised metal CLUB in one hand, facing the player; no guns or shields. Keep same overall human-height scale across cells, race anatomy varied. Read row by row left to right: row 1: (1) HUMAN, tan skin, short dark hair, weathered brown road coat; (2) ALIEN grey-blue long smooth head with black almond eyes, dark patched travel jacket; (3) MUTANT olive green skin, asymmetrical broad shoulders, slight tusks, battered vest; (4) SYNTH autonomous silver-blue humanoid robot, teal horizontal eyes, rust-patched coat. Readable distinct silhouettes. Complete heads, clubs, limbs and feet within each individual cell. No UI. This atlas will be cropped by grid at runtime.

Edit target: this exact 12-character NPC battle sprite atlas. Change ONLY the held metal club of EVERY character into a small clearly recognizable wasteland HANDGUN, dark iron with a short horizontal barrel, held aiming toward the viewer in a three-quarter angle. Adjust only the weapon hand/forearm as necessary for believable firing grip. Remove all clubs. Preserve all 12 identities, races, faces, clothes, body proportions, pose, cell positions, grid spacing, detailed 16-bit pixel clusters and muted palette exactly.
